title: UAR collaboration package authoring request
description: Authoring form for the official Draft 0.1.0-draft.1 documents. The compiler fills contentDigest, file inventory, byte digests, exact reference digests, and lock entries.

manifest.description: PackageManifest fields except computed contentDigest, files, and lock. Exact output is validated against schemas/uar/package-manifest.schema.json.

document.description: Exact canonical definition fields with top-level contentDigest omitted. Immutable reference digests may be omitted and are resolved from this package.
